title: Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A classic Peruvian dish, Beef Lomo Saltado is a stir-fry of tender beef strips, onions, tomatoes, and French fries, all served over a bed of rice.

ingredients.name: French fries
ingredients.notes: Cooked and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add French fries and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Return beef to skillet and stir in aji amarillo sauce and salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Serve hot over rice, topped with oozing cheese if desired.
